title: ChangesResult, QueryResult, AddedItem, QueryChangesResult missing Debug derive
description: backend.rs lines 198-245: the four public result structs have no derives at all. A backend implementor cannot print a ChangesResult or QueryResult for debugging (e.g. in tracing spans, in test failures). The rule of thumb is that Debug belongs on almost everything. These structs contain only Id, State, u64, bool, Vec, and Option fields — all of which implement Debug. Fix: add #[derive(Debug)] to ChangesResult, QueryResult, AddedItem, QueryChangesResult. (This should be done alongside adding #[non_exhaustive] in JMAP-isx.8.)
